hook: How to *Fail on AI Job Interview*
caption:
Oh it was PISSED

Someone decided to test Burger King's AI job interviewer by showing up shirtless with a shoe on his head and introducing himself as "Cranjis McBasketball."

The AI interviewer, Karen, immediately started questioning his appearance before asking whether he could reliably get to work.

When he replied, "Yeah, I have feet," Karen demanded a proper answer. Things got even worse when he called her a jackass, prompting the AI to go on a full rant about his behavior.

At one point, Karen said she was "absolutely appalled" and couldn't believe the audacity of someone speaking to her that way while wearing a shoe on his head.
